title: Other laws.
officialText:
The provisions of this code do not presumptively provide for matters that are contained in the charter, the
labor law, the multiple dwelling law, the zoning resolution, or the general city law. Where there is conflict or inconsistency between
the requirements of this code and other applicable laws and rules, unless otherwise required, such conflict shall be resolved in favor
of the more restrictive requirement.
